summary: Clean, MIT, provenance-signed headless components with good dialog/menu/listbox ergonomics, but a narrower component set than React Aria or Base UI and a surprisingly large install (about 63 MB with React 19). Hold it for simple Tailwind-style overlays; use React Aria for a broader foundation.
reasoning: Active release line: 2.2.10 published 2026-04-07; repository pushed 2026-04-13; 28.8k stars and 122 open issues.
MIT with a permissive tree; no required CSS runtime.
An npm attestation is present, but the publisher is a personal npm account rather than a trusted OIDC publisher.
No install scripts and no recorded OSV advisories.
The React 19 dialog spike opened with role=dialog and aria-modal=true, and moved focus inside.
The bundle was 239.38 KB / 76.76 KB gzip, but the install is about 63 MB with React 19.
The component set is narrower: dialogs, menus, listboxes, comboboxes, tabs, disclosures and form controls, without the broader table/date/time/drag-and-drop coverage of React Aria.
caveats: Install footprint is about 63 MB with React 19.
Provenance is present but not from an OIDC trusted publisher.
Good fit for Tailwind-based simple overlays, not for a broad greenfield design-system foundation.

evidence.label: License
evidence.detail: MIT; the isolated tree is MIT, Apache-2.0 and 0BSD only.

evidence.label: React compatibility
evidence.detail: peerDependencies react/react-dom: ^18 || ^19. The spike used React 19.2.0.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 5 runtime dependencies including React Aria focus/interactions; about 63 MB installed with React 19; 994 KB unpacked.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: No preinstall, install or postinstall script in the isolated tree.

evidence.label: npm provenance
evidence.detail: An npm attestation is present for 2.2.10, but the publisher is a personal npm account rather than a trusted OIDC publisher.

evidence.label: React browser spike
evidence.detail: A Vite production build rendered an open dialog in Chrome 1200x800 with role=dialog, aria-modal=true and focus inside. The JS bundle was 239.38 KB / 76.76 KB gzip including React 19.

evidence.label: Component coverage
evidence.detail: Narrower than React Aria: no broad table, date/time, drag-and-drop or internationalized collection layer.
